name: devbook
description: The devbook convention: .arc42, .domain, .tech, .design, and .ai folders of addressed Markdown chapters, each carrying a parseable meta block with status ladders, a shared approved rung and the review triad beside it, runnable test-case links, a reserved ext namespace, and annotation fences that keep a review note in the chapter beside the passage it is about. Ships three converters between chapters and code — sync-specs, apply-change, and verify-change, each over five chapter kinds — a versioned contract with runnable migrations, and the install that puts the rules and its AGENTS.md section into a repository. Ships the shape and never a flow or a tool: the delivery engine carries a chapter change, and devbook-derived ships the checker, the generator, and the canvas that enforce and derive from these rules.
